result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with faded zebra-stripe crosswalk markings and no visible pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present on both sides, they appear to be in fair to poor condition with some obstructions like trash bins and utility poles.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-stripe crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide roadway without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides near the crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The environment lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and modern safety enhancements like curb extensions, relying on standard vehicle signals for crossing guidance.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are worn and faded, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the side street.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: There are no visible pedestrian signal heads at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the intersection may block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, near the nail salon.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane urban roadway with commercial land use and a significant lack of pedestrian infrastructure. While traffic signals are present, there are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals, creating a high-exposure environment for anyone attempting to cross.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an unmarked, wide roadway without a designated path.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The excessive width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic during a crossing maneuver.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian-specific signals are visible to indicate when it is safe to cross, requiring pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the signalized poles on both sides of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information and improve safety at the intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a wide roadway with faded crosswalk markings and sidewalks on both sides. Visibility is compromised by parked vehicles and a large truck near the intersection, while the lack of dedicated pedestrian signals increases risk.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: A large black truck on the left and parked cars on the right block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the roadway near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can encourage higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.
